contexts.text: The truths of faith implanted in its good, which are also signified by the heavens have dropped, and the clouds have dropped waters (). AC 9420:end.
If any drop of it, not so moderated, were to touch them...
The heavens dropped, the clouds dropped waters = the instruction, influx, and perception of Divine truth. To drop = instruction and influx.
The dropping of honeycombs () = natural truth.
Intelligence and wisdom thence is signified by drops upon the grass, and drops upon the herbs ().
To drop is said of the influx, acknowledgement, and reception of truth.
